title: Genre Trend Persistence
scenario: Identify genres that have stayed in the Top 5 most-released genres for at least 3 consecutive years.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR, release_year INT)
hint: Rank genres by release count per year, then identify consecutive years.
correctQuery: SELECT genre FROM (SELECT genre, release_year, (release_year::INT - DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY release_year)) as grp FROM (SELECT genre, release_year, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY release_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk FROM games GROUP BY genre, release_year) t WHERE rnk <= 5) t2 GROUP BY genre, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR, release_year INT);
